Job Description GBS AI Factory Lead Job Title

GBS AI Factory Lead

Job Function

Operations

Location

GBISC Pune

Reports To

Head of Product Stream Enterprise Function

Mission / Purpose of the Job

Lead the GBS AI Factory in designing, developing, and scaling Agentic AI solutions.

Combine deep software engineering expertise, strong delivery leadership, and business alignment.

Deliver high-value, production-grade AI solutions across global finance processes.

Translate strategic AI vision into executed solutions by bridging business demand, data readiness, and engineering execution.

Drive measurable business transformation through scalable AI implementations.

Main Responsibilities AI Strategy & Delivery

Define and execute the roadmap for Agentic AI solutions across GBS.

Align AI initiatives with business priorities and measurable value delivery.

Lead the end-to-end delivery of AI solutions.

Oversee development and deployment of scalable, production-grade AI solutions.

Technical Leadership

Provide technical leadership and architecture direction.

Define engineering standards, architecture, and solution design.

Ensure robust, scalable, secure, and enterprise-compliant AI implementations.

Ensure alignment with enterprise IT standards and governance.

Team Leadership

Build and lead a high-performing AI Factory team.

Recruit, mentor, and develop multidisciplinary teams including AI Engineers, ABAP Developers, and Integration Engineers.

Foster a strong engineering culture and delivery excellence.

Innovation

Evaluate emerging AI technologies, including Agentic AI paradigms.

Drive structured experimentation and innovation.

Integrate new AI capabilities into scalable enterprise solutions.

Performance & Optimization

Monitor solution performance, adoption, and ROI.

Ensure sustainable integration of AI solutions into business operations.

Drive continuous optimization and improvement.

Skills / Knowledge / Experience Education

Masters Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field.

Experience

8 12 years of experience in software engineering and solution development.

Proven experience leading technical teams.

Experience managing complex project delivery.

Strong exposure to AI/ML or Intelligent Automation technologies.

Experience with Generative AI is preferred.

Experience in enterprise environments and large-scale digital transformation initiatives.

Required Skills Technical Skills

Strong software engineering and solution architecture background.

Experience with modern software development methodologies.

Cloud platform experience (Azure preferred).

Knowledge of Agentic AI.

Knowledge of Automation and Intelligent Workflow Orchestration.

Strong understanding of enterprise architecture.

Experience designing scalable AI solutions.

Strong software development lifecycle (SDLC) knowledge.

Business & Leadership Skills

Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.

Strong stakeholder management skills.

Excellent project management capabilities.

Program management experience.

Experience defining engineering standards and governance.

Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

Other Requirements

Excellent communication skills.

Strong leadership and people management capabilities.

Fluent English communication.

Strategic thinking ability.

Structured and execution-oriented mindset.

Ability to collaborate with global teams.

Scope of the Role

Lead the Global Business Services (GBS) AI Factory.

Establish and scale AI Factory capabilities.

Drive automation and intelligent process transformation.

Support GBS operations across multiple global regions.

Collaborate with:

Finance Leadership

Process Owners

IT Teams

Data Teams

Global AI Teams

Digital Strategy Teams

Lead AI initiative prioritization and delivery planning.

Manage the AI delivery pipeline.

Ensure quality, scalability, and governance of AI solutions.

Drive automation coverage and process improvements.

Improve AI capability maturity across GBS.

Lead and grow an AI Factory team of approximately 6 10 FTEs.

Influence multiple global business and technology stakeholders.

Key Success Measures

Successful delivery of AI initiatives.

Adoption of AI solutions.

Return on Investment (ROI).

Automation coverage.

Process efficiency improvements.

Quality and scalability of AI implementations.

AI delivery success rate.

Growth and maturity of AI capabilities within GBS.

Organization Structure

Head of Product Stream Enterprise Functions

GBS AI Factory Lead

GBS Systems Integration Engineer

GBS Agentic AI Solution Architect

GBS Agentic AI Engineer

GBS Agentic AI Engineer

GBS Systems Integration Engineer

O2C & Automation Manager
